## Trooper's Skate 3 Recomp Launcher v3.0.0: first public release

This is the **first public release** of Trooper's Skate 3 Recomp Launcher. It's an unofficial companion app for the [Skate 3 Recomp](https://github.com/mchughalex/skate3recomp) PC port. (The version number continues from the private builds I used before going public.)

### What it's for

The recomp is configured through a `settings.toml` file full of cvars. This launcher gives you a proper Windows app instead. You get every option on clean pages with plain-English help, plus the tools you need to keep the game running smoothly. Then you press **PLAY**. It's a single portable `.exe` that sits next to `skate3.exe`, with no installer and nothing extra to download.

### Highlights

- **Every setting, explained.** Display, Graphics, Lighting & Shadows, Controls, Audio & System, plus an **Advanced** page with search across every setting and raw editing of any cvar.
- **Quality presets** (Low / Medium / High / Ultra) with a **live VRAM estimate** for your GPU.
- **Conflict warnings** when settings clash, such as V-Sync with G-Sync or shadow options while the emulated renderer is on.
- **GPU picker** that lists your Vulkan GPUs with their VRAM, so the game never starts on integrated graphics. You can also set Windows' own graphics preference for `skate3.exe`.
- **Profiles:** save setups like "Ultra 4K" or "Ultrawide", switch in one click, and make desktop shortcuts that launch straight into one. The launcher also keeps a history of your last 15 settings saves.
- **Save backups:** your career is zipped automatically every time you press PLAY. Restore in one click; your current saves are always backed up first. There's also a DLC folder manager.
- **Logs and crash help:** a colour-coded log viewer, a check for whether the last session crashed, a pop-up after a crash, and one-click bug reports (copy or `.zip`).
- **Controller page:** a live XInput and DirectInput tester, a rumble test, and a recorder for the in-game settings-menu button combo.
- **Launcher tools:** update check for new recomp releases, shader-cache cleaner, system tray, Discord Rich Presence, and command-line quick play (`--play`, `--profile "Name"`).
- **Safe with your config:** only the keys you change are rewritten. Everything else in `settings.toml` is kept, and every save is backed up first.

### Install

1. Download `TroopersSkate3Launcher-v3.0.0-win.zip` below.
2. Extract `Trooper's Skate 3 Recomp Launcher.exe` into your Skate 3 Recomp folder, next to `skate3.exe`.
3. Run it. It needs Windows 10 or 11, which already includes the .NET Framework it uses.

The exe isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**. This release was built by GitHub Actions directly from the source in this repo.
